source.name: HC Traktor official site — 'Winline stal ofitsialnym partnerom chelyabinskogo Traktora'
source.quote: Договор, вступивший в силу 15 июля, рассчитан до конца сезона 2024/2025.
source.note: Russian; 'The contract, in force from 15 July, runs to the end of the 2024/25 season.' The club page shows no dateline; its sister Metaratings piece on the same deal is dated 15.07.2022. Reported value: 'up to 450 million roubles' over the term, per Metaratings (https://metaratings.ru/news/traktor-poluchit-do-450-millionov-rubley-po-mnogoletnemu-soglasheniyu-s-vinlayn-1312396/, 15.07.2022, opened 2026-10-03); the figure is in roubles, which the deal schema's currency enum (GBP/EUR/USD) does not support, so value is null.

note: Deal effective 15 July 2022 and running to the end of the 2024/25 season per the club's announcement (the source cited here); reported value up to RUB 450m over the term per Metaratings (see source note). stavka.tv (Oct 2026) still lists HC Traktor among Winline's 2026 club partners.
